notes.title: VTuber Maker new facial capture program go live(beta version)
notes.notes:
Update content:

1. Add a new facial capture program (beta version)

Path: Track>Webcam>Facial Tracking>Beta

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38374926/6d4fe6595bb16b9d84e6ec02cab164c2f51c482d.png[/img]
This version of the facial capture program is more stable than the one launched yesterday, but it has not yet undergone extensive testing. The current goal of launching Steam is to receive practical feedback from users.

2. The actual effect of the new facial capture program
[previewyoutube=FF-ZNx2Eaw8;full][/previewyoutube]
The facial capture screen is smoother and supports tongue out expressions.

3. Special instructions
The facial capture program launched today does not represent the final solution, everything still needs to be tested and verified. In addition, we are also in commercial negotiations with the company that provides this facial capture SDK

If you encounter any usage issues, please let us know in the VTuber Maker official Discord.
